findings.desc: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:166-173,439-441 — Prompt semantic drift only warns and still exits 0. On this branch `npm run test:process-fact-contract` already reports `.Codex/agents/koala-review-story-init.md` drift but still prints `Process fact contract verified`, so the new guard does not actually prove the prompts are drift-free as the added guidance claims. Fix: either fail on semantic drift that is meant to be forbidden, or narrow the documented guarantee to match the warning-only behavior.

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:98-125 — scanPromptText() only inspects the single line that contains koala finding_add, then looks for category and pass-only wording on that same line. A multiline example like koala finding_add followed by category=cleanup or desc=PASS on later lines will evade the scanner entirely. Fix: parse the full command block or use a multiline regex over the JSON payload, and add synthetic multiline negative cases to assertSyntheticAdversarialChecks().

CLAUDE.md:648 / docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:104-106 overstate the process-fact verifier guarantee: `npm run test:process-fact-contract` currently exits success even when prompt path semantics drift. In this worktree it prints a warning for `.Codex/agents/koala-review-story-init.md` vs template, because `comparePromptSemantics()` only fails command drift and downgrades path drift to warn at scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:170-173, despite the verifier scope saying wording differences are out of scope only when they do not alter commands or artifact paths at scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:419-420. Either make path-semantic drift fail, or soften the docs/prompt contract so pass behavior matches the implementation.
